Cora
or caura generally identified with a. of Caurapañcāśikā). Ref. to by Jayadeva in Prasannarāghava (yasyAzcorazcikuranikraraH); but ref. to a. distinct from Bilhaṇa by Jakkaṇa in his Telugu work Vikramārkacaritra. [Page086-a. See M. Krishnamachariar, His.. Classical Skt. Lit. p. 167.

Coraparīkṣā
mantra. a.. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 27.

Corabandha
Bud. Cordier II. p. 116. III. p. 76.

Corasaṃvāda
on the story of the combat between God Viṣṇu an. robber-chief Tirumaṅgaimannan an. the latter's conversion.

Corāśī(caturdaśī_?)āśātanā
Jain. Chani 2781 (āśātanānustavana). 2914.
--C. Avacūri. BP. p. 188a.
